en: A color illustration in classical religious style showing a young Jesus teaching in the Temple among a group of older men dressed in robes. Jesus, with a halo, stands in the center speaking, while the scholars around him listen, read from scrolls and books, and gesture in discussion. The background suggests the interior of an ancient temple or synagogue with columns and dim lighting.
